title: Show independently source-authorized canonical product ownership of selected Command item
goal: Deliver CAP-CMD-103 Class-0 product-owner distinction in selected six-view Work Queue current-page item, without reassigning operational ownership, inferring Identity details, or widening permissions.
invariants: Ownership Register owner product and operational Incident/Task Owner are distinct; only host-authorized external register source may provide canonical owner.
Selected incident or task is currently visible and CanRead-authorized under host session; source separately authorizes the canonical Ownership Register and Settings identity metadata.
No new HTTP route, permission model, client-supplied identity or Class-2 mutation; OPEN-013 applies to updates and history.
Parent PR #175 SHA 391e4b13ddde572d47a756590bd09bc036495e0b is Git stack parent only, NOT CAP-CMD-103 engineering parent.
security_properties: Never look up denied, missing, foreign or unselected work item in Ownership Register.
Reject unsafe or inconsistent register source claims with generic 503 before emitting current selected row.
html/template escapes untrusted registry text; nil source explicitly unknown; owner class never grants access to other source fields.

migration.rationale: Optional selected-only Class-0 host projection with unchanged prior clients and all six Work Queue routes.

rollback.strategy: Drop optional canonical Ownership Register projection preserving operational row ownership and prior SLA/factors.
verification: All earlier Work Queue functional tests.

inputs: Complete canonical CAP-CMD-103 §§1–27, CAP-CMD-101/102, 06-command module, Incident and Task objects and source/tenant permission contracts.
Previous selected-only Work Queue source adapters SLA and coordination factors on frozen PR #175 with successful exact-head CI.
outputs: Optional CanonicalOwnershipOwner adapter independently reading source-authorized ProductOwner and register source/version/identity-resolution state.
Separate JSON selected_canonical_ownership and escaped native HTML visible only for current selected row; no inferred canonical owner.
acceptance_tests: Current selected authorized Incident/Task asks independent Ownership Register only once with exact principal, tenant, environment and kind/id; no lookup on unselected/denied/foreign/out-of-page.
Canonical product owner remains distinct from operational row owner; unknown register/identity remains unknown; invalid claims and provider denial fail generic 503 without partial selection.
Untrusted HTML-shaped register content is escaped; no Class-2 source or owner mutation; earlier six-view route and SLA tests remain green.
Exact SHA command-work-queue-runtime and mandatory security/architecture/manifest checks pass without waivers.

performance_budget.rationale: One optional host source call for a selected authorized row; zero calls for unselected pages or denied rows.
metrics: At most one canonical Ownership Register read per selected request.
No extra queue listing or pagination traversals.
